ei.title: More Data By Imprecision Is Greater than Precise Data
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: More Data By Imprecision Is Greater than Precise Data

fullPassage: By the nineteenth century, France had developed a system of precisely defined units of measurement to capture space, time, and more, and had begun to get other nations to adopt the same standards. Just half a century later, in the 1920s, the discoveries of quantum mechanics forever destroyed the dream of comprehensive and perfect measurement. And yet, outside a relatively small circle of physicists, the mindset of humankind’s drive to flawlessly measure continued among engineers and scientists. In the world of business it even expanded, as the precision-oriented sciences of mathematics and statistics began to influence all areas of commerce. However, contrary to the trend of the past several decades, in many new situations that are occurring today, allowing for imprecision — for messiness — may be a positive feature, not a shortcoming. As a tradeoff for relaxing the standards of allowable errors, one can get a hold of much more data. It isn’t just that “more is better than some,” but that, in fact, sometimes “more is greater than better.”

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①정밀하게 ②파괴했다 ③ceased → continued ④긍정적인
det.analysis:
❌ ③ ceased → continued: 양자역학 발견 후에도 완벽한 측정에 대한 사고방식이 엔지니어와 과학자들 사이에서 '계속되었다'는 문맥. ceased(중단되었다)는 반대 의미

✅ ① precisely: 정밀하게 정의된 단위 — 문맥 적절

✅ ② destroyed: 양자역학이 완벽한 측정의 꿈을 파괴 — 문맥 적절

✅ ④ positive: 부정확함이 긍정적 특징일 수 있다 — 문맥 적절
det.tip: continued(계속되었다) ↔ ceased(중단되었다): 문맥상 '계속'이 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①포괄적인 ②확대되었다 ③부정확함 ④tightening → relaxing
det.analysis:
❌ ④ tightening → relaxing: 허용 가능한 오류의 기준을 '완화하는' 대가로 더 많은 데이터를 얻을 수 있다는 문맥. tightening(강화하는)은 반대 의미

✅ ① comprehensive: 포괄적이고 완벽한 측정의 꿈 — 문맥 적절

✅ ② expanded: 비즈니스 세계에서 더 확대되었다 — 문맥 적절

✅ ③ imprecision: 부정확함을 허용하는 것 — 문맥 적절
det.tip: relaxing(완화) ↔ tightening(강화): tradeoff 문맥상 기준 완화가 적절

✅ ③ 정상: The mindset ... continued among

questions.passage: By the nineteenth century, France had developed a system of precisely defined units of measurement to capture space, time, and more, and had begun to get other nations to adopt the same standards. In the world of business it even expanded, as the precision-oriented sciences of mathematics and statistics began to influence all areas of commerce. It isn’t just that “more is better than some,” but that, in fact, sometimes “more is greater than better.”
